name: Marching Tetrahedra 3 (DLC-Plane)
aliases: Dual Marching Tetrahedra - Diamond Lattice Crystal (DMT-DLC)
definition: A variant of Marching Tetrahedra that slices a point cloud plane at a time, generating a single calculation for all shared points to reduce point count. It uses a diamond crystal lattice structure composed of 5 tetrahedra per cell without fabricated points.
summary: Marching Tetrahedra 3 (DLC-Plane) is a volume meshing method using a diamond crystal lattice to generate isosurfaces without fabricated points, reducing boundary creases and computational overhead.
